ActionDescriptions.ToAddToolApprovalRequiredString:
to add an approval required command match
value - exact command or argument substring that should require approval when used by command/process execution tools. Creates the DB-backed policy feature from defaults when missing.
ActionDescriptions.ToApplyBuffalyUpdate:
to download and apply the latest buffaly update
Downloads and launches the configured Buffaly update path. This is a high-impact action and requires explicit user confirmation before execution.
ActionDescriptions.ToCheckBuffalyUpdate:
to check if buffaly can be updated
Checks configured Buffaly update metadata using system-owned settings. Does not download or apply updates.
ActionDescriptions.ToClearBuffalyLogs:
to prune buffaly error and debug logs
Deletes Buffaly *.log files older than OlderThanMinutes across all discovered log directories (primary + secondary roots from resolver). Default 60. Returns the standard Buffaly maintenance JSON result envelope (deleted count, bytes freed, list of affected files, warnings). This is a high-impact destructive action. Agent behavior must require explicit user confirmation before calling.
ActionDescriptions.ToDownloadLatestBuffalyInstaller:
to cache the latest buffaly installer
Downloads the latest configured Buffaly installer and validates SHA-256 when configured. Does not launch or apply it.
ActionDescriptions.ToEnsureToolExecutionPolicyConfigured:
to create the database backed tool execution policy
Creates the DB-backed Tool Execution Policy Feature from compiled defaults when missing. Returns the resulting policy summary.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalyLogPath:
to resolve buffaly diagnostics log directory
Returns JSON text containing the primary Buffaly log directory and discovered log directories. No parameters are required.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalyMaintenanceStatus:
to check buffaly update and log status
Returns JSON text with version, update availability, log path state, recent error count, and warnings.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalyVersion:
to check what version of buffaly is installed
Returns JSON text containing resolved install root, installed version, and warnings. No parameters are required.
ActionDescriptions.ToLaunchLatestBuffalyInstaller:
to update buffaly using the latest installer
Downloads if needed and launches the latest Buffaly installer through the system-owned update path. Agent behavior should require user confirmation before calling this action.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewClearBuffalyLogs:
to dry-run clear old buffaly logs
Dry-run version of log clearing. Returns the same data shape as ToClearBuffalyLogs but performs no deletions. Use this before calling the destructive version.
ActionDescriptions.ToRemoveToolApprovalRequiredString:
to remove an approval required command match
value - exact command or argument substring to remove from approval-required rules. Creates the DB-backed policy feature from defaults when missing.
ActionDescriptions.ToShowToolExecutionPolicy:
to inspect hard deny and approval required tool policy
Returns JSON showing the active tool execution policy source, hard-deny rules, approval-required rules, approval text, and approval timeout.
ActionDescriptions.ToUploadBuffalyErrorAndDebugLogs:
to upload buffaly debug logs
Uploads discovered Buffaly error and debug logs to Herd using system-owned instance identity, Herd URL, and upload caps.
ActionDescriptions.ToUploadBuffalyErrorLogs:
to upload local buffaly errors
Uploads discovered Buffaly error logs to Herd using system-owned instance identity, Herd URL, and upload caps.
ActionDescriptions.ToUploadCurrentSessionLogs:
to upload this session diagnostics
Uploads current-session logs to Herd. includeDebug=false uploads errors only; includeDebug=true includes debug logs.
